title.zh: IER 重新分级：马来西亚 MAS-01 重型队通过复审

summary.en: Congratulations to the Malaysian Urban Search and Rescue Heavy Team (MAS-01) on successfully passing the INSARAG External Reclassification (IER) in Malaysia from 21 to 25 September 2026! This recognition affirms the team’s exceptional skills and its commitment to international search and rescue. The INSARAG Secretariat extends its sincerest congratulations.
summary.zh: 马来西亚城市搜索与救援重型队（MAS-01）于2026年9月21日至25日在马来西亚顺利通过 INSARAG 外部重新分级认证（IER）。

content.en: Congratulations to the Malaysian Urban Search and Rescue Heavy Team (MAS-01) on successfully passing the INSARAG External Reclassification (IER) in Malaysia from 21 to 25 September 2026! This recognition affirms the team’s exceptional skills and its commitment to international search and rescue. The INSARAG Secretariat extends its sincerest congratulations.
content.zh: 祝贺马来西亚城市搜索与救援重型队（MAS-01）于2026年9月21日至25日在马来西亚顺利通过 INSARAG 外部重新分级认证（IER）！此次认证充分肯定了该队出色的专业能力及其对国际搜救事业的坚定承诺。INSARAG 秘书处向该队致以最诚挚的祝贺。
